# garmin-mcp-auth

Garmin Connect sign-in for Garmin MCP, the unofficial MCP server for Garmin Connect: SSO, MFA, DI OAuth2 tokens and refresh. Not affiliated with Garmin.

This package is part of [Garmin MCP](https://endurancetools.github.io/garmin-mcp/) and is installed with it; its API is internal and may change in any release. To use Garmin MCP, install the server and sign in with the CLI:

```bash
npx -y garmin-mcp-cli login
claude mcp add garmin -- npx -y garmin-mcp-server
```

- Documentation: [endurancetools.github.io/garmin-mcp](https://endurancetools.github.io/garmin-mcp/)
- MCP server: [garmin-mcp-server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/garmin-mcp-server)
- Source: [packages/auth](https://github.com/endurancetools/garmin-mcp/tree/main/packages/auth)
